name: Piloos Doc
description: Read and edit Word (.docx) files on your phone: headings, lists, bold and italic, fonts and sizes, tables and pictures. Opens files straight from other apps, keeps a draft of your edits, and works offline.

workflowSuggestions.title: Soạn thảo Word
